title: DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay Opens, Marking Brand’s Singapore Debut
summary: Hilton has officially opened DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay, marking the brand’s debut in Singapore.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **Located on Havelock Road, the 344-room hotel offers a relaxed riverside base within easy reach of Robertson Quay, Chinatown, Tiong Bahru, Clarke Quay and the Central Business District, with Havelock MRT Station only a five-minute walk away**
- **The hotel introduces two new dining concepts, SAUS and Brew:33, alongside seven meeting rooms, an outdoor pool, wellness studio and 24-hour fitness centre**


**SINGAPORE –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) has officially opened[DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/sindidi-doubletree-singapore-robertson-quay/) , marking the[brand’s](https://stories.hilton.com/brands/doubletree-by-hilton) debut in Singapore and introducing its signature warmth, comfortable hospitality and thoughtful touches to one of the city’s most established riverside neighbourhoods.


Set along the Singapore River in the lively Robertson Quay precinct, the 344-room hotel pairs the energy of city life with the ease of quayside living, offering a well-connected base for business and leisure travellers. From the moment they arrive, guests are welcomed with the brand’s beloved warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie, a symbol of DoubleTree by Hilton’s longstanding commitment to care. That spirit continues throughout the stay, from warm service and thoughtfully designed spaces to familiar comforts that help guests feel relaxed, well looked after and at ease.


Beyond the hotel, guests can easily explore some of Singapore’s most distinctive neighbourhoods, with Robertson Quay, Chinatown, Tiong Bahru and Clarke Quay within walking distance, while the Central Business District is also within easy reach. With Havelock MRT Station about a five-minute walk away and bus connections nearby, the hotel provides convenient access to Orchard Road, Sentosa and destinations across Singapore.


“Singapore continues to be a key market for Hilton in South East Asia, valued for its strong business community, global connectivity, and enduring appeal to travellers from around the world,” said Alexandra Murray, area vice president and regional head of South East Asia, Hilton. “The debut of DoubleTree by Hilton in Singapore strengthens our portfolio with a brand known for making guests feel genuinely welcomed and well cared for. Robertson Quay’s riverside setting and neighbourhood character make it a fitting home for the brand, offering travellers a comfortable base to experience the city at a more relaxed pace while adding a warm new gathering place to the precinct.”


## A Comfortable Riverside Stay


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay features 344 guest rooms and suites ranging from 24 to 50 square meters, with more than 200 rooms overlooking the Singapore River. The hotel offers a range of accommodation options to suit different stay occasions, from King, Queen and Twin Guest Rooms for solo travellers, couples, and friends, to selected rooms and suites featuring pull-out sofa beds for added flexibility. The hotel also offers four Deluxe Suites, and 11 connecting queen and twin rooms for families and groups travelling together.


Each room is equipped with a 55-inch HDTV, complimentary Wi-Fi, a dedicated work desk, coffee and tea making facilities, and Crabtree & Evelyn bath amenities, bringing together familiar comforts designed to make each stay effortless. Across the guest rooms and public spaces, warm earthy tones, terracotta accents, greenery and tactile natural materials create a clean, contemporary setting with a relaxed, residential feel. Thoughtful details and locally inspired touches further connect the hotel to its riverside surroundings and the easy rhythm of Robertson Quay.


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay - King Deluxe Room River View with Sofa Bed


Guests can keep to their wellness routines at the 24-hour fitness centre, making time for quiet movement at the wellness studio, or unwinding at the outdoor pool, with daybeds and cabanas for sunny days or shaded relaxation.


The hotel also offers seven versatile meeting rooms and spacious pre-function areas for corporate gatherings, intimate celebrations and private events. Each venue can accommodate 20 to 40 guests, while Clemenceau I and Clemenceau II can be combined to host up to 70 guests, giving planners added flexibility for meetings, social occasions and small celebrations. Selected meeting rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light, supported by in-house audio-visual capabilities and dedicated workstations for focused moments between sessions.


## Two new dining concepts for Robertson Quay


SAUS is an all-day restaurant that brings homegrown flavours and heritage cooking techniques to comfort food. Taking its name from a playful spin on “sauces”, the restaurant places condiments at the centre of the dining experience, using sauces, dips, marinades and sambals to bring new depth and dimension to familiar dishes. Its “Four Corners of Flavour” showcases more than 40 house-made condiments across four categories featuring Singapore flavours, Southeast Asian culinary traditions, spicy classics and umami-rich marinades.


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay - SAUS Rendering


Menu highlights include Nyonya Prawn Salad, Grilled Lemongrass Chicken, Signature Beef Rendang with Wagyu cheeks slow-cooked in an eleven-spice rempah, Seafood Bakar with hand-pounded sambal olek, and Bak Kut Teh simmered with a blend of spices and herbs. Signature drinks range from nostalgic local favourites such as Air Bandung, Milo Dinosaur and Soya Bean to house cocktails, kombucha, juices, coffee and tea.


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay - Brew:33 Rendering


At the other end of the lobby, Brew:33 brings together the easy sociability of a neighbourhood café and bar. Inspired by three simple pleasures - coffee, cookies and craft beer, the 64-seat lounge transitions through the day, from morning coffee and midday treats to evening pours.


Brew:33 serves specialty coffee from local and regional roasters, signature chilled drinks such as Choco Chip Cookie Crush, Mango Coffee Latte, and Strawberry Oat Latte, as well as craft beers from small-batch local breweries, including Osmanthus Pear Cream Ale and Galactic Tropical Stout. Small bites include Grilled Satay and The Local “Bak Kwa” Sliders, a playful take on familiar flavours. With floor-to-ceiling windows, living room-style seating and a pet-friendly alfresco area, Brew:33 is designed as a relaxed gathering point for guests, locals and Robertson Quay regulars.


At the heart of the lobby, DoubleTree by Hilton’s signature Ritual Hub offers a dedicated zone for guests and families to slow down, connect and take part in complimentary hands-on activities. This October, guests can enjoy a cookie-making workshop inspired by the brand’s signature cookie, with more new activities to be introduced in the months ahead.


“DoubleTree by Hilton has always been built on the brand belief that there is great power in small things; they make all the difference. Through comfortable spaces, thoughtful amenities and genuine human connections, we inspire guests with feel-good moments from check-in to check-out,” said Vincent Ong, vice president, Full Service Brands, Asia Pacific, Hilton. "At DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay, that spirit of care comes to life through warm service and everyday moments that help guests feel at ease, whether they are travelling for work, leisure or a bit of both. With SAUS and Brew:33, the hotel also creates welcoming spaces for the wider neighborhood to gather, dine and connect."


## Exclusive Pre-Opening Promotion


To celebrate its opening, DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay is offering a special promotion for Hilton Honors members, with 1,000 bonus Hilton Honors Points awarded for every night stayed, capped at five nights. The offer will be available for stays from 30 September to 31 December 2026 **.**


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay is part of Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest-loyalty program for Hilton’s 28 distinct hotel brands. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including a flexible payment slider that allows members to choose nearly any combination of Points and money to book a stay, exclusive member discounts, free standard Wi-Fi and the Hilton Honors app. Through the mobile app, members can also check in, select their room and unlock their room door using Digital Key.


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay is located at 401 Havelock Road, Singapore 169631. For more information or to make a reservation, visit[doubletreebyhiltonsingapore.com](http://doubletreebyhiltonsingapore.com/) .


To learn more about DoubleTree by Hilton, visit[stories.hilton.com/doubletree](https://stories.hilton.com/brands/doubletree-by-hilton) .


1Lunch and dinner service will start from 1 November 2026.


##### FAQ: DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay Opens in Singapore


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay is a 344-room riverfront hotel located along the Singapore River in Robertson Quay. Opened on 30 September 2026, it marks the debut of DoubleTree by Hilton in Singapore, bringing the brand’s signature warm welcome, comfortable hospitality and thoughtful touches to the city for the first time.


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay is located at 401 Havelock Road, Singapore 169631, in the lively Robertson Quay precinct along the Singapore River. The hotel is within walking distance of Robertson Quay, Chinatown, Tiong Bahru and Clarke Quay, near the Central Business District, and only a five-minute walk from Havelock MRT Station, with bus connections nearby to Orchard Road, Sentosa and the wider city.


The hotel features 344 guest rooms and suites ranging from 24 to 50 square metres. The accommodation mix includes 224 rooms overlooking the Singapore River and 120 rooms facing the surrounding neighbourhood, with King, Queen and Twin Guest Rooms, rooms and suites with sofa beds, four Deluxe Suites, three accessible rooms and connecting room options for families and groups.


DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay features two dining concepts: SAUS, an all-day restaurant serving comfort food with local flavour, and Brew:33, a 64-seat neighbourhood lounge and bar built around coffee, cookies and craft beer. SAUS showcases more than 40 house-made condiments through its “Four Corners of Flavour,” while Brew:33 offers coffee, warm cookies and craft beer at different points of the day.


The hotel offers an outdoor pool with daybeds and cabanas, a 24-hour fitness centre, wellness studio, seven versatile meeting rooms and spacious pre-function areas. Individual meeting rooms accommodate 20 to 40 guests, while Clemenceau I and Clemenceau II can be combined to host up to 70 guests. To celebrate the opening, Hilton Honors members can receive 1,000 Hilton Honors Bonus Points for every night stayed, capped at five nights, for stays from 30 September to 31 December 2026. Guests should book via the confirmed official hotel booking link once live.
